[May 2021] May 17th, 2021 to be exact

 

TV 2's [Isabella Martinsen](https://i.sli.mg/Jr5bI4.jpg) is reporting:

Today is the [National Day of Norway](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Norwegian_Constitution_Day). Various festivities will be seen throughout the cities of Norway as the citizens show their patriotic pride. The women and men dress up in costumes before they join the festivities. [1](https://i.sli.mg/oo3OG1.jpg), [2](https://i.sli.mg/TBGRds.jpg)

The events include:

* In Oslo, children from all the city's schools gather to [parade past the Royal Palace](https://i.sli.mg/ZoX6jx.jpg), where they and the [Royal Family exchange waves and greetings](https://i.sli.mg/7vbZc1.jpg). * In the municipality of Asker, outside Oslo, the [children gather outside the residence of the throne heir](https://i.sli.mg/8F67L8.jpg) at Skaugum Estate in the morning (giving the Prince and his family time to attend the parade in Oslo later in the day). * [Bergen](https://i.sli.mg/lzoXfU.jpg) has its own traditions for the parade, including comic troupes, various local organizations, [a children's parade](https://i.sli.mg/L2F3S7.jpg), and the unique [buekorps](https://i.sli.mg/eb9RRj.png)(marching band). * In Trondheim, children from all the city's schools parade the [streets of Trondheim](https://i.sli.mg/amllbZ.jpg) in the morning. Later in the afternoon, the "Citizens Parade" (Borgertoget) starts. This is a parade where firefighters, sports teams, [students associations](https://i.sli.mg/BkN0VE.jpg) and [other associations](https://i.sli.mg/90Hatc.jpg) are represented. * In Kristiansand, in addition to parades of schoolchildren and citizens earlier that day, the city is known for the conclusion of the National Day with dancing in the streets ("Tapto") and [spectacular fireworks](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=M2hNZiTyL0s).

In addition to the children's parades the streets across the country are filled with young and old, turning out in festive attire, and vendors selling ice cream, hot dogs, and lately, [kebabs](https://i.sli.mg/fOBbq7.jpg)(I'm serious).

The graduating class from the Norwegian equivalent of high school, known as russ, has its own celebration on May 17, [staying up all night](http://www.adressa.no/forbruker/article6672515.ece/ALTERNATES/w980-default/IMG_xruss1.jpg_1_1_AG1V930.jpg) and making the [rounds](https://i.sli.mg/XMsmzF.jpg) [through](https://farm3.staticflickr.com/2323/2509779922_521d4d3dda_b.jpg) the [community](https://i.sli.mg/U4TxCF.jpg). The russ also have their own [parades](https://i.sli.mg/v7hBWI.jpg) later in the day, usually around 4 or 5 PM. In this parade, russ will parade through the street with their [russebil](https://i.sli.mg/eS0MKb.jpg) (russ car) carrying signs and pickets. They may [parody](https://i.sli.mg/xPhO4M.jpg) various local and political aspects, although recently this has become less frequent. Russ parades have lately become smaller and smaller due to diligent police discouragement.

 

Even Lillian has joined in on the celebrations! [1](https://i.sli.mg/geNr8Q.jpg), [2](https://i.sli.mg/PNtBvc.jpg)
